subject: POC Trial RACI & Next Steps - AcmeHealth
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Sanjay Patel <sanjay.patel@acmehealth.com>; Priya Rao <priya.rao@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-28T15:12:00-08:00
Subject: POC Trial - Recap + Proposed RACI and Next Steps

Hi Sanjay / Priya —

Thanks again for the call earlier — great alignment on objectives. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum on the AcmeHealth POC: 

Recap (from today's discovery):
- Objective: Validate Redwood inference for clinical note summarization and triage integration in Acme's provider portal.
- Primary success criteria discussed: 1) 95% semantic fidelity on a 200-sample eval set (annotated by clinical SMEs), 2) end-to-end latency under 300ms median for common prompts, 3) no PHI exfiltration (KMS + audit logs verified).
- Scope: 2-week technical evaluation with limited dataset (de-identified sample) + integration test with staging provider portal.

Proposed RACI (high level) — see attached Acme_POC_RACI_v1.xlsx for editable copy:
- Redwood: Responsible — POC infra & deployment, model configuration, eval harness.
- Acme App Team (Priya): Accountable — integration work, acceptance testing.
- Acme Infra/SRE (Sanjay): Consulted — staging infra access, network/security config.
- Procurement (Tom): Informed — any purchase/order approvals and timelines.

Immediate next steps I propose: 
1) Acme to confirm infra contact and staging access window (action: Sanjay) — due by 2026-12-01.
2) Redwood to deliver POC runbook + eval plan (action: Marissa & Aditya) — due by 2026-12-02.
3) Kickoff and environment handoff: week of 2026-12-07 (target).

Please reply with any corrections to the RACI or the success criteria. If this looks good we can lock owners and I will send the runbook and the evaluation template.

Thanks —
Marissa
Marissa Cole | Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | (415) 555-0132

Attachments: Acme_POC_RACI_v1.xlsx, Acme_POC_Success_Criteria.docx
From: Sanjay Patel <sanjay.patel@acmehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>; Priya Rao <priya.rao@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Tom Erickson <tom.erickson@acmehealth.com>
Date: 2026-11-29T09:08:00-08:00
Subject: Re: POC Trial - Recap + Proposed RACI and Next Steps

Thanks Marissa — helpful summary. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Confirming success criteria in principle; clinical SME review will be run by our Clinical Ops team and we'll share the annotation schema by 2026-12-02. Priya to lead on that.
- For infra: Please loop in our SRE lead (Vivek Kumar) — I manage procurement & platform partnerships but Vivek will handle staging access and network policy. I'll introduce him on this thread by EOD.
- Procurement: Tom here — timeline-wise, procurement will need a short statement of work and expected spend estimate. If the POC stays within the credit budget we can proceed faster; otherwise expect a 2–3 week procurement review.

Action items from Acme:
- Introduce SRE contact (Sanjay) — by 2026-11-30 (I will add Vivek).
- Share annotation schema (Priya) — by 2026-12-02.
- Flag procurement owner for any SOWs (Tom) — noted.

We'll wait on the runbook — looking forward to the kickoff schedule.

Best,
Sanjay
Director, Platform Engineering
AcmeHealth
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Sanjay Patel <sanjay.patel@acmehealth.com>; Priya Rao <priya.rao@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Michael Grant <michael@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-01T10:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: POC Trial - Recap + Proposed RACI and Next Steps

Appreciate the fast replies — Sanjay/Tom noted. A couple updates and clarifications after internal alignment: 

1) SRE contact — thanks Sanjay, please add Vivek and I'll update the runbook for the network checklist.
2) Procurement path — understood, to keep momentum we'll include two options in the runbook: (A) POC under Redwood eval credits (preferred, no procurement required), (B) short SOW (one-page) with estimated up-front cost. We will flag both scenarios so Tom's team can decide.
3) Success criteria specifics (proposed, editable in attached doc):
   - Quality: >=95% semantic agreement on clinical-summary pairs (200-sample blinded test).
   - Latency: median <300ms for canonical prompts, p95 <700ms on staging hardware.
   - Security: Red team verification + encrypted data in transit and at rest; KMS-held keys; audit log access for Acme.

RACI (detailed, summarized inline):
- Responsible: Redwood (Aditya) — deploy POC image, run eval harness, provide logs and token-level cost reports.
- Accountable: Acme App (Priya) — sign-off on integration tests and acceptance criteria.
- Consulted: Acme SRE (Vivek) + Redwood infra eng (Michael) — network and infra config.
- Informed: Procurement (Tom) + Legal (we'll loop in only if SOW needed).

I've attached the RACI and success criteria docs and included a short timeline suggestion:
- 12/02: Runbook + Eval plan delivered by Redwood (Aditya).
- 12/07: Kickoff + environment access begins.
- 12/08–12/19: Run POC (10 business days).
- 12/20–12/22: Evaluation window + acceptance decision.

Please confirm owners (Vivek for infra, Priya for app) and whether procurement will need the SOW option. If all good I'll schedule the kickoff for 12/07 and share a calendar invite.

Thanks —
Marissa

Attachments: Acme_POC_RACI_v1.xlsx, Acme_POC_Success_Criteria.docx
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-02T08:37:00-08:00
Subject: Internal: Confirming infra owner and runbook items before send

Marissa / Aditya — quick internal note before we finalize the runbook: 

- Michael to be primary Redwood infra contact during the POC for any kernel/tuning or deployment issues. He'll be on the kickoff and will own incident triage.
- Aditya to own the eval harness (data ingestion, 200-sample blinded test, metric reports).
- Checklist to include: staging IP allowlist + port matrix, KMS key exchange steps, sample data de-id checklist, and red-team smoke test schedule.

I'll review the runbook when you drop it and help coordinate invites with Acme.

Lauren
Director, Customer Success
Redwood Inference
From: Tom Erickson <tom.erickson@acmehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>; Sanjay Patel <sanjay.patel@acmehealth.com>; Priya Rao <priya.rao@acmehealth.com>
Date: 2026-12-05T09:04:00-08:00
Subject: Re: POC Trial - Recap + Proposed RACI and Next Steps

Marissa — this looks good. Confirming procurement preference: we'll try to keep the POC within available partnership credits. If that doesn't work, I'll escalate the one-page SOW; please include an estimated not-to-exceed cost in the runbook.

Also please include a short acceptance sign-off template we can use at the end of the POC (one checkbox per success criteria). That will speed acceptance.

See you on 12/07 for kickoff.

Thanks,
Tom
Director, Strategic Partnerships
AcmeHealth
